name: brief
does: Read the inspo and note, write a structured brief or a refusal

name: provision
does: Get or create the product sandbox from the builder snapshot, copy inspo files to inspo/, write brief.md and fixtures, set the network policy

name: build
does: Run muse exec detached and stream its JSONL events

name: preview
does: Start next dev on port 3000 and save sandbox.domain(3000)

name: verify
does: npm run verify, collect screenshots, ask the judge

name: fix
does: Resume the Muse Code session with the failures

name: record
does: Rerun the test with Demo Studio's recorder, then edit it into a 1920x1080 MP4 and a poster

name: deploy
does: Read source out of the sandbox and deploy it as the product's Vercel project

name: register
does: Save the product, mint its live gateway token, build its MCP tools

name: hibernate
does: Stop the sandbox so it snapshots for later refinements
